impacted.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s that are impacted by the updates to the {@link Sensor}s.
This means that for the relation, it's source of truth model uses at least one of the {@link Sensor}s as
a feature or mask.

notImpacted.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s that are not impacted by the updates to the {@link Sensor}s.

unverifiable.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s that had special cases for which it was not possible to validate
that the relation's source of truth model uses or does not use the {@link Sensor}s as a feature or mask.

For example: If the model's {@link Feature.Set}s use a lambda feature that could use data from any sensor.

impactedSensors.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s that are impacted with the list of impacted {@link Sensor} ids.

name: FaultySensor.ImpactedRelationsBatchResult
